title: 训练达标预测（Copilot 只读预测器）

standard.summary: 读取已训练 run 的 loss / 验证 loss / L2 时序
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Reads the loss, validation loss and L2 time series of a finished run
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 读取已训练 run 的 loss / 验证 loss / L2 时序，做饱和幂律趋势外推，判定收敛/发散并预测达到目标阈值所需步数，回答"按当前趋势能否在总步数内达标"。纯只读建议，不改动训练参数、不进入训练主链。

advanced_en.principle: Reads the loss / validation loss / L2 time series of finished runs, fits a saturating power-law trend, judges convergence/divergence, and predicts the number of steps needed to reach a target threshold — answering "can the goal be met within total steps at the current trend". Read-only advisory; changes no training parameters and stays out of the main training chain.
